description: Repo-scale (gin-helpdesk): add an atomic all-or-nothing bulk ticket status update endpoint
prompts: Add `POST /api/tickets/bulk-status`, body `{ ticketIds: [...], status: "..." }`. It must validate the WHOLE batch before changing anything: reject with 400 (and change NOTHING) if `status` is not one of open/in_progress/closed, or if ANY ticketId in the list does not reference an existing ticket - even one bad id anywhere in the list must leave every ticket's status completely untouched, not just the ones after the bad id. Only once every id is confirmed to exist should the whole batch actually be updated. On success return `{ tickets: [...] }`, the updated tickets in the same order as `ticketIds`.

reference_solution.internal/api/router.go:
package api

import "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"

func NewRouter() *gin.Engine {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	r := gin.New()
	r.Use(gin.Recovery())

	r.POST("/api/agents", createAgent)
	r.GET("/api/agents", listAgents)
	r.GET("/api/agents/:id", getAgent)

	r.POST("/api/tickets", createTicket)
	r.GET("/api/tickets", listTickets)
	r.GET("/api/tickets/:id", getTicket)
	r.PATCH("/api/tickets/:id", updateTicket)
	r.POST("/api/tickets/bulk-status", bulkUpdateStatus)

	r.POST("/api/tickets/:id/comments", createComment)
	r.GET("/api/tickets/:id/comments", listComments)

	return r
}
